2: //!
3: //! Implements 10 checks for MATLAB Compiler deployment constraints.
4: //! Deployed MATLAB applications (compiled with `mcc`) run in a restricted
5: //! environment where certain functions are unavailable or behave differently.
6: //!
7: //! ## Checks
8: //!
9: //! | ID | Severity | Description |
10: //! |----|----------|-------------|
11: //! | MCCD | Error | `cd` in deployed code |
12: //! | MCPRD | Error | Path modification in deployed code |
13: //! | MCHLP | Warning | `help`/`doc` in deployed code |
14: //! | MCKBD | Warning | `keyboard` in deployed code |
15: //! | MCSVP | Warning | `savepath` in deployed code |
16: //! | MCMLR | Warning | `matlabroot` in deployed code |
17: //! | MCABF | Error | `addpath` with absolute path |
18: //! | MCMFL | Warning | `mfilename` in deployed code |
19: //! | MCTBX | Warning | Toolbox function in deployed code |
20: //! | MCLL | Error | License check in deployed code |
21: //!
22: //! ## Configuration
23: //!
24: //! ```toml
25: //! [lint.rules.DEPLOYMENT_ENGINE]
26: //! skip_checks = ["MCTBX"]
27: //! ```

144:     /// Check a `function_call` node for deployment-restricted functions.
145:     fn check_function_call<'a>(
146:         &self,
147:         node: tree_sitter::Node<'a>,
148:         source: &'a str,
149:     ) -> Vec<Diagnostic> {
150:         let mut diags = Vec::new();
151: 
152:         let func_name = match extract_func_name(node, source) {
153:             Some(n) => n,
154:             None => return diags,
155:         };
156: 
157:         // MCPRD: addpath / rmpath / path modification
158:         if self.is_enabled("MCPRD")
159:             && (func_name == "addpath"
160:                 || func_name == "rmpath"
161:                 || func_name == "path"
162:                 || func_name == "pathtool"
163:                 || func_name == "restoredefaultpath")
164:         {
165:             diags.push(make_diag("MCPRD", node));
166: 
167:             // MCABF: addpath with absolute path (additional check)
168:             if self.is_enabled("MCABF")
169:                 && func_name == "addpath"
170:                 && has_absolute_path_arg(node, source)
171:             {
172:                 diags.push(make_diag("MCABF", node));
173:             }
174:         }
175: 
176:         // MCHLP: help / doc
177:         if self.is_enabled("MCHLP") && (func_name == "help" || func_name == "doc") {
178:             diags.push(make_diag("MCHLP", node));
179:         }
180: 
181:         // MCKBD: keyboard
182:         if self.is_enabled("MCKBD") && func_name == "keyboard" {
183:             diags.push(make_diag("MCKBD", node));
184:         }
185: 
186:         // MCSVP: savepath
187:         if self.is_enabled("MCSVP") && func_name == "savepath" {
188:             diags.push(make_diag("MCSVP", node));
189:         }
190: 
191:         // MCMLR: matlabroot
192:         if self.is_enabled("MCMLR") && func_name == "matlabroot" {
193:             diags.push(make_diag("MCMLR", node));
194:         }
195: 
196:         // MCMFL: mfilename
197:         if self.is_enabled("MCMFL") && func_name == "mfilename" {
198:             diags.push(make_diag("MCMFL", node));
199:         }
200: 
201:         // MCTBX: Toolbox functions
202:         if self.is_enabled("MCTBX") && TOOLBOX_FUNCTIONS.contains(&func_name) {
203:             diags.push(make_diag("MCTBX", node));
204:         }
205: 
206:         // MCLL: license check
207:         if self.is_enabled("MCLL") && func_name == "license" {
208:             diags.push(make_diag("MCLL", node));
209:         }
210: 
211:         diags
212:     }

215:     fn check_command<'a>(
216:         &self,
217:         node: tree_sitter::Node<'a>,

219:     ) -> Vec<Diagnostic> {

238:         if self.is_enabled("MCPRD") && (cmd_name == "addpath" || cmd_name == "rmpath") {

329: /// Check if a function_call has an argument that looks like an absolute path.
330: /// Detects strings starting with '/' (Unix) or drive letters like 'C:\' (Windows).
331: fn has_absolute_path_arg(node: tree_sitter::Node, source: &str) -> bool {
332:     let count = node.child_count();
333:     for i in 0..count {
334:         if let Some(child) = node.child(i) {
335:             if child.kind() == "string" {
336:                 let text = node_text(child, source);
337:                 let inner = text.trim_matches('\'').trim_matches('"');
338:                 // Check for Unix absolute path or Windows drive letter
339:                 if inner.starts_with('/')
340:                     || (inner.len() >= 3
341:                         && inner.as_bytes()[0].is_ascii_alphabetic()
342:                         && inner.as_bytes()[1] == b':'
343:                         && (inner.as_bytes()[2] == b'\\' || inner.as_bytes()[2] == b'/'))
344:                 {
345:                     return true;
346:                 }
347:             }
348:             // Recurse into arguments node
349:             if child.kind() == "arguments" && has_absolute_path_arg(child, source) {
350:                 return true;
351:             }
352:         }
353:     }
354:     false
355: }
